notes.title: Robosoul 0.7.2 EA
notes.notes: For progressing forward, the current official beta has made been public and steam images have been updates. With many graphic and gameplay updates, this however is only an in-between update to bring out 0.9.x updates. We are sorry that the 0.8.x updates had only internal testing but we promise to bring you regular news from now on again. A lot of work has been gone into Robosoul so far and we are polishing 0.9.x for public EA release so stay tuned.

notes.title: Robosoul 0.6.11 EA
notes.notes:
Small fixes before 0.7.0:

[list]
[*] Fixed controller issues
[*] Seperated jump and block buttons
[*] Closing blueprints with controller now works
[*] Fixed lilly pad height
[*] Fixed particle with wrong texture
[/list]

notes.title: Robosoul 0.6.10 EA
notes.notes:
Some quick fixes and minor updates based on user feedback:

[list]
[*] Fixed gate bugs with player spawing and re-entering
[*] Fixed energy pickup screen flash bug
[*] Added a light to the pistol
[*] Improved UI look for the editor
[/list]

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Robosoul 0.6.9 EA
notes.notes:
Update for [i]Robosoul 0.6.9 EA[/i] is mostly about adjustments, gamepad support and polishing ...

[list]
[*] Experimental Gamepad support (native Xbox support, Steam Controller, etc.)
[*] Minor shoot collision fix (fixes close range collision for gun shots)
[*] Level fix in "rs-practice"
[*] Adjusted difficulty settings
[*] Adjusted spawn time for NPC in "rs-mother"
[*] Increased inital simulation energy to 150 (more time to learn the game)
[*] Adjusted dialog timing for mother-soul
[*] Added screen-effect for mother-soul
[/list]

Next up is 0.7.0 which will be a content-update (more levels, more blueprints, more story) and level-editor polishing. Live in a few days.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
After 2.5 years of development, it was decided to take a step forward and release [i]Robosoul: From the Depths of Pax-Animi[/i] to the public via Early Access!

We are happy to share, what we believe is a great game, with gamers, fans and friends around the world.

Let us know what you think and help us shape [i]Robosoul: From the Depths of Pax-Animi[/i] to the best game it can be!

In case you ever have a problem, suggestion or an idea for the game, meet us in the discussion board of the game here at Steam.

Hope to see you there ;)

Bastian
